title: Marsh Island
summary: A remote wetland rendezvous beyond Vermilion Bay in Compromised's Gulf Coast storyline.

claims.text: Compromised describes Marsh Island as a former wilderness refuge beyond Vermilion Bay, reached by water through surrounding wetlands.
The island is the location of the rogue arms rendezvous with Cassandra Raines and the Reborn, where the manipulation of the Gulf Coast factions is exposed.

paragraphs.text: The novel uses Marsh Island's isolated wetlands as the meeting point for a covert arms transfer beyond Vermilion Bay.

verification.notes: Geographic description is limited to the novel's fictional-use account and is not a real-world travel reference.
